item.title: AI Has Human Doctors Asking: What’s Left for Us?
item.description: A recent paper argues that AI is often better at doctoring than doctors. Guess who isn't thrilled.

item.title: He Scraped All of Their Art for AI. Now He’s Collaborating on a Tool to Help Them
item.description: The art portfolio platform Cara, designed for creators who don’t want their work used to train AI, has been under assault by trolls seizing and publishing its data.

item.title: Inside Meta’s Push to Put Robots to Work in Data Centers
item.description: The company is testing robots that can swap cables, reset servers, and take on other tasks performed by technicians, fueling concerns among some workers that their jobs could be at risk.

item.title: A Judge Has Blocked the Pentagon’s Attempt to Blacklist Anthropic
item.description: A federal judge has called the Department of Defense’s designation of Anthropic as a national security supply-chain risk “illegal and baseless.”

item.title: AI Agents Are Hacking Systems. Could That Push the US and China to Cooperate?
item.description: This week on “Uncanny Valley,” senior writer Will Knight talks his recent visit to China and the future of AI collaboration.

item.title: A Georgia Cop Used Flock to Track 2 Other Cops: His Ex and Her Friend
item.description: After an affair with a fellow police officer ended, a Georgia cop used Flock to track her movements—and those of a man whose vehicle often showed up near hers, internal investigation records show.

item.title: This Is How Anthropic Thinks AI Agents Should Navigate the Physical World
item.description: The potential for AI to automate scientific research and manufacturing must be balanced with new risks, Anthropic says.

item.title: OpenAI Is Developing a ‘Persistent’ AI Agent
item.description: Code reviewed by WIRED reveals the company is developing a feature that enables Codex to continue working proactively until it is “put to sleep.”

item.title: Submit Your Questions: The Great Data Center Backlash
item.description: You have questions about data centers, and WIRED has answers. Join our livestream on September 10 and our panel of experts will tell you everything you need to know.

item.title: Stop Touching Your Keyboard. Use This AI-Powered Microphone Instead
item.description: The Relay Q, due next year, is the latest attempt to reposition voice as the most seamless method for human-computer interaction.
